user.title: Home Battery Analysis
user.description: Detected P1 meters are pre-selected. Select all consumption and feed-in tariffs (e.g. tariff 1 + 2) so totals are correct.

data_description.price_export: Net compensation per fed-in kWh. If you pay feed-in costs per kWh (newer contracts, or once net metering ends in 2027), enter a negative value, e.g. -0.07: the battery then also saves those costs for every stored kWh.

error.required_import: Select at least one consumption meter.
error.required_export: Select at least one feed-in meter.
error.overlap: Import and export may not contain the same entity.
error.schema_error: Internal error loading the form; check the logs.
